notes.hook: The counterintuitive paradox of starting a fire to survive immediately hooks the viewer.
notes.clarity: The progression is straightforward, though explicitly mentioning the moment he lit the escape fire would make beat 5 clearer.
notes.payoff: The tragic contrast between Dodge surviving in his burned patch and his crew running into the flames delivers a powerful punch.
notes.visuals: Authentic archival imagery from smokejumpers and Mann Gulch keeps the visuals grounded and sharp.
notes.loop: The crew perishing in the flames transitions smoothly back into Dodge's survival method.

rounds.better_than_last: The paradoxical hook immediately grabs attention and resolves with a poignant, historically grounded payoff.
